mutants.description: fault_arbiter's soft-start scope also covers S_HICCUP, as if the cool-down and its soft-start retry were one episode, so the overcurrent windows and the CP history are not cleared during the hiccup
mutants.reason: fault_arbiter clears its windows only when neither of its state inputs is high, so with this change a hiccup no longer wipes them. After a RUN window trip, the RUN count stays at or above trip_run through the cool-down and the retry ramp, so the converter goes straight back to S_HICCUP (En drops, another strike, and eventually latch_out) on the first clock of S_RUN. After a soft-start trip, window_trip_SS is still high when S_SS is re-entered, so the retry trips again at once.

mutants.description: The supervisor's switch enable is ANDed with the raw synchronised switch, following a 'switch-off must act at once' idea, so only the press is debounced and a release or bounce takes effect immediately
mutants.reason: Turning the switch on still waits the full 20 ms qualification. But when the switch is released, or bounces low for even one clock while the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN, En drops and the FSM goes to S_OFF straight away, not 20 ms later. The reg_file switch status stays at its debounced value the whole time.
